subBlocks.title: Setup Instructions
subBlocks.default:
1. Go to your Meta for Developers Apps page and navigate to WhatsApp > Configuration.
2. Find the Webhooks section and click Edit.
3. Paste the Webhook URL above into the Callback URL field.
4. Paste the Verification Token into the Verify token field.
5. Click Verify and save.
6. Subscribe to the messages webhook field.

triggers.instructions:
1. Go to Meta for Developers Apps page.
2. Select your App, navigate to WhatsApp > Configuration.
3. Click Edit in the Webhooks section.
4. Paste the Webhook URL into the Callback URL field.
5. Paste the Verification Token into the Verify token field.
6. Click Verify and save.
7. Click Manage next to Webhook fields and subscribe to messages.
